EXPLANATIONS.Physical_Mechanism: Sub-surface fatigue micro-spalling in bearing inner race resulting in elevated high-frequency demodulation energy without immediate rise in overall RMS velocity.
EXPLANATIONS.Cross_Variable_Corroboration: Corroborated by +8 C bearing metal temperature elevation and ISO 4406 particle count jump to 19/17/14.
EXPLANATIONS.Operational_Significance: Early leading indicator allowing 4-6 week planned intervention before catastrophic seal failure.

EXPLANATIONS.Physical_Mechanism: Heavy asphaltene deposition on crude tube-side creating boundary layer insulation and elevating tube wall skin temperature.
EXPLANATIONS.Cross_Variable_Corroboration: Corroborated by simultaneous 1.4 bar delta-P increase across preheat bank and 12 C furnace inlet temperature deficit.
EXPLANATIONS.Operational_Significance: Forced increase in fuel gas consumption at F-101 furnace to maintain column flash zone target.

EXPLANATIONS.Physical_Mechanism: Dry gas seal face carbon transfer due to momentary reverse differential pressure transient during compressor speed ramp.
EXPLANATIONS.Cross_Variable_Corroboration: Corroborated by primary vent flow transmitter FT-601 step change from 1.2 to 2.8 Nm3/h.
EXPLANATIONS.Operational_Significance: Degraded secondary seal barrier requiring continuous nitrogen purge verification.
